what: A REAL pre-v2 iBeetKidz save, captured out of a browser's localStorage. Not hand-typed.
why: Every other migration fixture in tests/unit/project-state.test.ts is written from memory, so it proves normalizeProject handles the shape the author REMEMBERED. This one is the shape the app actually wrote.

howCaptured.whyThatCommit: d047d61 is the parent of 72f7d30 ("feat(core): replace arrangement with flat TrainCar model (v2 Phase 1)") — i.e. the LAST commit whose running app persisted the pre-v2 `arrangement` shape.

userActions: Add Kick, Add Snare, Add Synth
toggled kick hits on steps 0/4/8/12, snare on 4/12
placed melody notes at rows 2/4 on steps 0/6/10

shapeNotes: Top-level keys: activeMachineId, activePartId, activeView, arrangement, clips, id, keyId, name, parts, scaleId, swing, tempoBpm — NO `schemaVersion`, NO `train`.
Part keys: color, id, layers, name — NO `carType`, so normalizeProject must derive it (drum+melody car -> boxcar).

FINDING: no ibeetkidz UI ever shipped a control that sets `repeats` to 2 or 4 (`git grep repeats` over src/components + src/machines across the pre-v2 history hits only READERS). The 2|4 expansion branch in normalizeProject is therefore dead in the wild — real saves only ever exercise repeats: 1. The hand-typed test above it still covers 2|4, and it stays: the field is in the persisted shape, so a save could carry it.
